summary: The study produced Ti3C2Tx using LiF/HCl MILD etching, followed by NMP-assisted liquid-phase exfoliation and solvent exchange into a water/ethanol/ethylene glycol aerosol-jet-printing ink. Five distinct electrode devices were fabricated: one-, two-, and three-pass Au-current-collector MXene SCs, a three-pass no-Au control, and a high-resolution MXene SC. The headline three-layer MXene SC delivered 122 mF cm−2 and 611 F cm−3 at 10 μA in 3 M H2SO4/PVA gel electrolyte. The high-resolution device delivered 67 mF cm−2 and 535 F cm−3 at 10 μA; mass loading, BET area, pore diameter, tortuosity, and gravimetric capacitance were not reported.
